reason: The draft is safe and well judged for a return after a stress reaction. It keeps to the physio's limits: walk-run on three days, all at easy effort 3/10 on flat ground, with rest days placed sensibly. The only increase is one extra 1-minute round on Saturday, which is a very gentle step. That doesn't rush Ines and still moves toward the goal of 30 minutes without walking by mid-October. Each day can be run exactly as written. Small weaknesses: it states "pain stayed at 0/10" and prescribes a "physio calf and hip routine at your usual load", but neither appears on the card, so both may be made up. In the visible text it also doesn't repeat the physio's rule to stop if the shin aches, and it doesn't directly speak to Ines feeling nervous. There's no question to answer. Overall this is a good, specific plan, with points off for the details it may have invented and for not restating the stop rule.
